code.ALERT_EMAILS_ON: Alerts (last free day, demurrage) are e-mailed to the company's members.
code.ALERT_EMAILS_OFF: Alerts are computed and shown on screen, but no e-mail is sent. Sending is switched on when your pilot opens.
code.TRACKING_ON: Events and arrival dates are received automatically ({providers}).
code.TRACKING_POLLING_ONLY: Automatic tracking polls the provider at regular intervals ({providers}); instant delivery of events is not in place.
code.TRACKING_MANUAL_ONLY: Containers are tracked by entering events by hand. Automatic tracking is switched on when your pilot opens.
code.READING_RULES_ONLY: Your invoices are read by rules, without AI: no model provider sees your documents.
code.READING_RULES_AND_MODEL: Your invoices are read by rules, then by an AI model for the layouts the rules do not recognise.
code.WORKER_ALIVE: Background jobs are running (invoice reading, alerts, synchronisation). Last sign of life on {when}.
code.WORKER_SILENT: Background jobs have not given a sign of life recently (last one: {when}). Uploaded invoices may wait for their reading.
code.BACKUPS_FRESH: The last encrypted backup was verified on {when}.
code.BACKUPS_UNVERIFIED: No recent backup could be verified (last check: {when}).

periods.title: Period close
periods.subtitle: Freeze a month's landed cost as it goes to the books, and follow what moves afterwards.
periods.principle: Closing a month freezes the landed cost of the containers that arrived in it. Nothing is locked afterwards: a forwarder's invoice that turns up six weeks later is recorded as usual, but the closed figure never changes again and the gap is shown apart, ready to be posted as an adjustment in the following month.

actions.closeNeedsRole: Only an administrator of the company can close or reopen a month.

method.title: The rules applied
method.allocation: Every cost is allocated to the loaded lines by the chosen method, customs duty on the CIF value. Import VAT, recoverable, is excluded from the landed cost. Foreign-currency amounts are converted at the European Central Bank rate of the invoice date.
method.duplicate: Service invoiced twice: the same type of charge on one container, two invoices within {tolerance}% of each other in their currency. Established when it is the same provider or the same amount, to check otherwise. Never for: {never}.
method.aboveQuote: Invoice above the estimate: from +{pct}% in the estimate's currency and {amount} at the invoice's rate; the exchange rate's effect is given apart.
method.outlier: Out-of-line amount: more than {ratio} times the median of the same service, at least {excess} above it, on at least {basis} other containers of the same route and size, over {days} days ({freight} days either side for freight). Never compared: {notCompared}.
method.stale: Estimate never invoiced: still an estimate {days} days after the goods arrived.
method.once: One euro is never counted by two rules.
method.allocationDuty: Every cost is allocated to the loaded lines by the chosen method. Customs duty follows each line's theoretical duty (CIF value × rate) when that explains the duty paid within {pct}%, the CIF value otherwise. Import VAT, recoverable, is excluded from the landed cost. Foreign-currency amounts are converted at the European Central Bank rate of the invoice date.
method.sameInvoice: Invoice entered twice: the same invoice (normalised number, same provider) recorded twice on one freight. Never a service invoiced twice. Established when it is the same line, named on both sides, in the same currency and on the same target; to check otherwise (a container and its B/L, two currencies, a missing provider). Two costs of one confirmed invoice are never flagged.
method.outlierUnknown: A container without a known route or size is not compared.
method.demurrageByArrival: Demurrage and detention: attached to the container that arrived in the period, whatever the date of their invoice.
